newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow airports handled 174,400 T cargo in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Moscow airports handled 174,400 T cargo in 1996.

text.p: Moscow's four airports handled 174,400 tonnes of cargo and mail in 1996, Russia's Federal Aviation Service (FAS) said in statement on Monday.
It did not give comparative figures for 1995.

Domodedovo airport handled 79,400 tonnes of cargo and mail last year, Vnukovo airport handled 45,700 tonnes, Sheremetyevo international airport processed 45,300 tonnes and Bykovo handled 4,000 tonnes in 1996.

Over January to April of this year, Domodedovo, used by Russian carriers for domestic and international flights and a few Western carriers for international flights, handled 36,300 tonnes of cargo, its press service said on Monday.
Russian Transport minister Nikolai Tsakh said last week that Domodedovo would be privatised soon, but he gave no details.
